subject: Cloud cost vendor selection — procurement plan & next steps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need vendor shortlist & procurement plan for FinOps tooling

Dylan —

Quick background: Infra and platform have been running a 30-day evaluation of NimbusFinOps as part of our cloud cost tooling shortlist (Nimbus, CloudSight, and FinSight). Early signals look promising on anomaly detection and prefix-level allocation, but we need a procurement plan if we decide to move forward. Budget envelope is ~$120k ARR for tooling + one-off onboarding services.

Asking you to:
- Coordinate with procurement to get required vendor paperwork (W-9, SOC2, TIN)
- Confirm PO timeline and who will raise the PO if we sign (Monica?)
- Draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) and target go-live date (ideally May 1)

Also please surface any discount levers (commitment length, seats, onboarding fees waiver) so we can present to finance.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex@NimbusFinOps.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: se_engineer@NimbusFinOps.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: NimbusFinOps proposal & SOW for Redwood — pricing and next steps

Hi Dylan / Monica —

Thanks for running the pilot with Nimbus — very glad the team is seeing value. I've attached our standard proposal, an editable SOW, and a pricing spreadsheet for line-item clarity. Highlights:
- Platform: cost allocation, anomaly detection, automated tagging rules, and CI/CD integration.
- Onboarding: 2 weeks of remote onboarding + 8 hours of custom tag mapping (one-time).
- Pricing: $10k/mo list for the platform (12-month commitment) + one-time onboarding $6k.

Attachments: Nimbus_Proposal_2026-03.pdf; Nimbus_SOW_v1.docx; Nimbus_pricing_breakdown.csv

We can offer a 30% partner discount for a 12-month commitment if Redwood signs by April 15. For procurement, please send PO instructions and any required forms. If helpful, I can put you in touch with our legal ops and finance contact to speed up DocuSign.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Enterprise Account Executive — NimbusFinOps
alex@NimbusFinOps.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusFinOps proposal & SOW for Redwood — pricing clarification + legal questions

Team —

Quick read-through of Nimbus's materials attached. A few questions before we engage legal & issue a PO:
1) Can they break the monthly into environment-based billing? We need separate chargebacks for hosted vs. infra-managed (prod vs. non-prod).
2) Data handling: they claim support for customer-managed KMS — Grace, can you confirm that their KMS integration meets our baseline?
3) Compliance: ask for SOC 2 Type II and evidence of subprocessor list.
4) Finance: Neha, their standard term is Net 30 — would Net 45 be a hard requirement for us?

Also propose we take the 30% discount if legal confirms no repo climb on data retention clauses. Monica, can you request a pilot extension through April 30 to finish the last integration tests (we still have one outstanding tag plan item)?

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex@NimbusFinOps.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: se_engineer@NimbusFinOps.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: NimbusFinOps proposal & SOW for Redwood — answers + SOC2 and extended pilot

Hi Dylan / Monica —

Thanks — quick answers inline below.

On Thu, Mar 26, 2026 at 09:45 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Can they break the monthly into environment-based billing?
Yes — we can provide line-item billing by project/environment. We’ll include a billing code column in the pricing breakdown.

> 2) Customer-managed KMS?
We support CMK via AWS KMS and BYOK flows. Our engineering team will share a short integration checklist.

> 3) SOC2 / subprocessor list?
SOC 2 Type II report: https://nimbusfinops.com/soc2/REDACTED (secure link). Subprocessor list attached in the proposal appendix.

> 4) Net 30 vs Net 45?
We typically do Net 30 but can agree to Net 45 for enterprise accounts with a standard onboarding signature.

Pilot extension: we can extend the trial through 2026-04-30 and provide an additional 4 hours of engineering support to finish tag mapping.

Discount: confirmed — 30% off the first year with a 12-month commitment if signed by 2026-04-15.

I'll drop a DocuSign link for the SOW once you confirm procurement details and the preferred billing contact.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Enterprise Account Executive — NimbusFinOps
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusFinOps proposal — Procurement asks

Folks —

Finance checklist before I can approve an external vendor spend:
- Separate line-items for recurring SaaS vs professional services in the pricing spreadsheet (this is for CapEx / OpEx classification).
- Vendor W-9 and legal entity name + TIN.
- Standard vendor-side insurance limits (we usually require $1M GL).
- PO terms: we prefer Net 45 for annual vendors; confirm whether Nimbus accepts Net 45.
- Any pass-through customer data obligations need to be explicit in SOW (retention window, deletion on termination).

Monica — please ask Nimbus for the W-9 and updated pricing CSV that splits SaaS and services. If they can accept Net 45 and provide the W-9, I can sign off on the budgeted spend.

-Neha
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@NimbusFinOps.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: SOW sign & PO next steps

All —

After reviewing the updated pricing and SOC2 evidence, we are green to proceed with Nimbus under the following conditions:
- 12-month commitment at the negotiated rate (30% off list)
- Net 45 payment terms (finance approved)
- Pilot extended through 2026-04-30; Nimbus to provide 4 hours of additional engineering support for tag mapping
- SOW to include explicit data retention and deletion language (Grace/legal to confirm)

Monica — please raise a PO against deal_id DEAL-2026-1843 and include NimbusFinOps legal name and W-9. Alex — send the DocuSign SOW link and the final pricing CSV that splits SaaS vs services.

I'll loop legal after Monica raises the PO to get the SOW over the finish line. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Dylan Brooks
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
